endpoint.eligible_population: class-correct one-to-one rotated-IoU >= 0.50 matched pairs with GT aspect ratio >= 2.1
endpoint.image_aggregation: mean over retained eligible matches; images with no retained eligible match are zero

fixed_selection_rule.score_rule: threshold is the source D_cal all-prediction score quantile for the declared nominal coverage
fixed_selection_rule.candidate_rule: first coverage in descending grid whose UCB <= risk budget

ap_only_policy.selection_basis: highest registered DIOR-R baseline mAP; no orientation abstention

orientation_policy.selection_basis: lowest preselected-coverage DIOR-R D_audit continuous d_tip among source-feasible candidates

target_mapping.target_threshold_protocol: read HRSC D_cal prediction score,image_id,prediction_id columns only; apply the sealed 0.90 score quantile; commit/push TARGET_THRESHOLD_SEAL before opening HRSC D_audit GT/outcome
target_mapping.target_audit_protocol: one class-aware matching pass and paired image bootstrap only after target threshold seal

target_gate.decision_change: architecture differs and orientation nominal coverage is 0.90
target_gate.continuous_delta: AP-policy mean_d_tip minus orientation-policy mean_d_tip >= 0.02 and paired 95% lower > 0
target_gate.ap50_survival: orientation AP50 no more than 0.02 below AP policy
target_gate.sensitivity: benefit positive at >=2 of q={0.25,0.50,1.00}; q=.50 primary passes

implementation.cpu_note: Only 200 frozen source images were matched; this small deterministic task did not effectively use 80% of 48 cores.
